hints: Replacing $x$ with $x - 1$ represents a horizontal shift.
Multiplying by $2$ represents a vertical stretch.
walkthrough:
Identify the horizontal transformation given by $f(x - 1)$:
$$\text{Translation by vector } \begin{pmatrix} 1 \\ 0 \end{pmatrix} \text{ (or } 1 \text{ unit in the positive } x\text{-direction)}$$

Identify the vertical transformation given by the factor $2$:
$$\text{Stretch with scale factor } 2 \text{ parallel to the } y\text{-axis (in the } y\text{-direction)}$$

hints: Stretch with scale factor $1/3$ in the $x$-direction replaces $x$ with $3x$.
walkthrough:
Apply reflection in the $y$-axis to $y = \sin(2x) - 5x$ by replacing $x$ with $-x$:
$$y = \sin(2(-x)) - 5(-x) = \sin(-2x) + 5x = -\sin(2x) + 5x$$

Apply stretch with scale factor $\frac{1}{3}$ in the $x$-direction by replacing $x$ with $3x$:
$$y = -\sin(2(3x)) + 5(3x) = -\sin(6x) + 15x\quad\left(\text{or } \sin(-6x) + 15x\right)$$
